For $n=1$, the condition is $x_1 \mid (x_1 - 1)(x_2 - 1)$.

Since $3^k$ is divisible by 3 (as $k \ge 1$), we must have $-1 \equiv 0 \pmod 3$, which is false.
Therefore, $p \ne 3$.
